title: Among all accounts opened in districts where the average salary exceeds 10,
question: Among all accounts opened in districts where the average salary exceeds 10,000, identify those that also have at least one outgoing order (from the 'order' table) with a purpose of 'UVER' (loan payment). For these accounts, compute the total transaction amount in 1997, and return the top three districts (by name) with the highest such totals, along with the number of qualifying accounts per district.

prediction.sql:
WITH high_salary_districts AS (
    SELECT XCL_017
    FROM district
    WHERE XCL_031 > 10000
),
qualifying_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.XCL_001, a.XCL_002
    FROM account a
    INNER JOIN high_salary_districts hsd ON a.XCL_002 = hsd.XCL_017
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM "order" o
        WHERE o.XCL_041 = a.XCL_001
          AND o.XCL_045 = 'UVER'
    )
),
district_totals AS (
    SELECT
        d.XCL_017,
        d.XCL_018,
        COUNT(DISTINCT qa.XCL_001) AS account_count,
        SUM(t.XCL_051) AS total_amount
    FROM qualifying_accounts qa
    INNER JOIN district d ON qa.XCL_002 = d.XCL_017
    INNER JOIN trans t ON qa.XCL_001 = t.XCL_047
    WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', t.XCL_048) = '1997'
    GROUP BY d.XCL_017, d.XCL_018
)
SELECT
    XCL_018 AS district_name,
    account_count,
    total_amount
FROM district_totals
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH qualifying_districts AS (
    SELECT XCL_017
    FROM district
    GROUP BY XCL_017
    HAVING AVG(XCL_028) > 10000
),
qualifying_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.XCL_001, a.XCL_002
    FROM account a
    INNER JOIN qualifying_districts qd ON a.XCL_002 = qd.XCL_017
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM "order" o
        WHERE o.XCL_041 = a.XCL_001
        AND o.XCL_045 = 'UVER'
    )
)
SELECT
    d.XCL_018 AS district_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT qa.XCL_001) AS qualifying_account_count,
    SUM(t.XCL_051) AS total_transaction_amount_1997
FROM qualifying_accounts qa
INNER JOIN district d ON qa.XCL_002 = d.XCL_017
INNER JOIN trans t ON qa.XCL_001 = t.XCL_047
WHERE t.XCL_048 LIKE '1997%'
GROUP BY d.XCL_017, d.XCL_018
ORDER BY total_transaction_amount_1997 DESC
LIMIT 3

),
district_totals AS (
    SELECT
        d.XCL_017,
        d.XCL_018,
        COUNT(DISTINCT qa.XCL_001) AS account_count,
        SUM(t.XCL_051) AS total_amount
    FROM qualifying_accounts qa
    INNER JOIN district d ON qa.XCL_002 = d.XCL_017
    INNER JOIN trans t ON qa.XCL_001 = t.XCL_047
    WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', t.XCL_048) = '1997'
    GROUP BY d.XCL_017, d.XCL_018
)
SELECT
    XCL_018 AS district_name,
    account_count,
    total_amount
FROM district_totals
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 3
